from pathlib import Path
p=Path('test/units/plugins/connection/test_ssh.py')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"from ansible import context\\n\", \"from ansible import context\\nfrom ansible.utils.context_objects import CLIArgs\\n\")
s=s.replace(\"monkeypatch.setattr(context, 'CLIARGS', {'ssh_common_args': '-o ProxyJump=cli'})\", \"monkeypatch.setattr(context, 'CLIARGS', CLIArgs({'ssh_common_args': '-o ProxyJump=cli'}))\")
s=s.replace(\"    process.wait.return_value = check_status\\n\", \"    process.wait.return_value = check_status\\n    process.communicate.return_value = (b'', b'')\\n\")
s=s.replace(\"C.DEFAULT_SCP_IF_SSH = \", \"conn.set_option('scp_if_ssh', \")
# Close transformed assignments.
lines=[]
for line in s.splitlines():
    if \"conn.set_option('scp_if_ssh', \" in line and not line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
        line += ')'
    lines.append(line)
s='\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n'
s=s.replace('C.ANSIBLE_SSH_RETRIES = 9', \"conn.set_option('retries', 9)\")
# Retry tests mock get_option and expect configured retries.
import re
s=re.sub(r\"monkeypatch.setattr\\(C, 'ANSIBLE_SSH_RETRIES', (\\d+)\\)\", r\"self.conn.set_option('retries', \\1)\", s)
# The first four retry tests replace get_option with a mock; preserve effective retry count.
start=s.index('class TestSSHConnectionRetries')
head, tail=s[:start],s[start:]
# all mock replacements in this class are after a retries setting and otherwise use True; use local option value
parts=tail.split(\"self.conn.get_option = MagicMock()\")
new=parts[0]
for part in parts[1:]:
    part=part.replace(\"self.conn.get_option.return_value = True\", \"self.conn.get_option.side_effect = lambda option: self.conn._options['retries'] if option == 'retries' else True\",1)
    new += \"self.conn.get_option = MagicMock()\"+part
s=head+new
p.write_text(s)
